correctness.rationale: For every trace on an antichain, the ideal interval has both parities unless it is a singleton; this is proved from a minimal free element. The maximum antichain edge-count equality forces one consecutive block of chosen maxima. The complete rigid-trace test reduces to covering internal minima and excluding all external maxima; its unique ideal has size (r+1)+|E|+|T|. These facts prove the exact parity classification, VC dimensions, and exceptional binomial counts. Top homology follows by eliminating extra top-facet coefficients, with explicit m=1,2 graph cases. Direct independent bitmask enumeration checks 328 size-m antichain/parity comparisons for m<=8 and top boundary ranks for m<=5. All infinite assertions are proof-based.

value.rationale: The odd fence is a standard family of distributive lattices with established rank-enumeration theory. The new parity-refined Boolean trace invariant distinguishes two natural halves of that lattice. An all-order maximum-face classification yields a one-unit VC-dimension loss and an unexpectedly short binomial defect (1,3,3,1). The exact top integral homology proves a persistent boundary-sphere cycle for all m and isolates the only additional top cycles. These are motivated structural, not arbitrarily selected finite benchmark computations; no downstream theorem is required for their value.
